name: Chiseled Enchanting Table (Unofficial 26.1.2 Port)
description: Unofficial community port of Sacramentix's Chiseled Enchanting Table to Minecraft 26.1.2 / Fabric. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. A rework of enchantment progression: you can now enchant your gear using enchanted books placed in nearby chiseled bookshelves using a chiseled enchanting table.

custom.chiseled_enchanting_table:port_notes: Unofficial community port to Minecraft 26.1.2. Includes worldgen-safe chiseled bookshelf filling and facing, full dyeable Chiseled Enchanting Table rendering/drop support, stackable 64 enchanted books, configurable anvil prior-work cost scaling (RemoveXpCostScaling), depth-scaled Mineshaft Efficiency II-V loot, complete 29-advancement progression and 1019 UI/config/guide strings localized across all 11 shipped languages, 80-option in-game configuration with Classic/Modern Rule Trace, full S2C cost and rule synchronization (26_1_2_revision_18), rainbow cloth (jeb_ easter egg) table cosmetics, bounded Shift-detail tooltips, engineered modular internals with real server/client integration smoke gates, and optional JEI/REI/ModMenu integration. Active mixins live in chiseled-enchanting-table-port.mixins.json. See CURRENT_BASELINE.md, docs/WIKI.md, and docs/EXTENDING.md for details.
